evidence.summary: News: Home Ranch sold in 2019, ended its run as a resort, now a private home.
Ranch reopened as events venue for weddings and retreats; no ski operations mentioned (snippet).

comment: Old steamboatxcski.com candidate is a hijacked spam site. Closure sources are news only and do not name skiing explicitly; homeranch.com shows no winter or ski content.

evidence.summary: Plain Valley report says a February 2026 Nordic Cup race moved to Stevens Pass Nordic Center (snippet).
Resort winter page lists Nordic Center cross-country and snowshoe trails.

comment: Dedicated Nordic Center page sits behind a Vail waiting-room redirect and could not be read, so the resort winter page is used as officialUrl.

evidence.summary: Sun Valley Nordic page, seen 11/22/2026, sells 2026-27 Nordic and snowshoe season passes; trails closed until snow.
Ranch skiing page describes 15 km groomed classic and skate trails, with a Spring Break 2027 promotion banner.
Club trail report says some trails open for skiing, chalet closed for renovation; site carries a 2026 strategic document.

comment: Likely same centre as another Whitehorse entry if one exists; name is the Whitehorse Nordic Centre (Mt. McIntyre).

evidence.summary: White River National Forest page, updated 12/16/2025, lists over 35 km groomed trails, season from late November.

comment: Operates on national forest under a permit; the operator's own site was not loaded, so the land manager page is officialUrl.
